description: This file defines a centralized mock function type for use with the Vitest testing framework within the project. It creates a type alias for mocks of functions, intended to be used across test utilities, especially for harness modules under `src/`.

ctags.name: MockFn
ctags.pattern: /^export type MockFn<T extends (...args: any[]) => any = (...args: any[]) => any> =$/
